title: 第15章 陛下恕罪第16章 欺人太甚
lines: 宁自明发现宁宸偷偷跑出去了，气得不轻。
他担心宁宸把最近发生的事说出去，万一传到玄帝耳朵里，那可就糟了！
宁自明左等右等，没等到宁宸，却等到了宫中传召太监。
听说玄帝召他进宫，宁自明心里直打鼓，忐忑不安！
他悄悄给传召太监塞了银子，想要打听玄帝为何召见他？
可传召太监银子是收了，但一问三不知...其实他是真的不知道。
宁自明跟着传召太监来到皇宫御书房。
全公公就在门口站着，皮笑肉不笑的看着他。
宁自明心生不妙，急忙跪倒高呼：“臣宁自明，求见陛下！”
“嘘...宁大人，陛下正在处理政务，切勿喧哗，等着便是！”
宁自明只能跪在门外等着。
他很想从全公公嘴里打探消息，但全公公却转身进去了。
宁自明这一跪就是两个多时辰。
他是个文官，身娇体弱，跪的膝盖生疼，眼冒金星，感觉腰都快断了。
但玄帝没召见他，他就得一直跪着。
直到他快坚持不住的时候，全公公出来了。
“宁大人，随我进去面圣吧！”
宁自明挣扎着起身，两腿直打摆子，长时间跪着，猛地起身，血脉不通，眼前一黑差点栽倒。
他拼了老命稳住身子。
殿前失仪，那可是大不敬。
他哆哆嗦嗦地进到御书房，再次跪拜，高呼：“臣宁自明，参见陛下！”
玄帝的目光从手里的奏折上移开，眼神冷漠地看了他一眼。
宁自明额头冷汗直冒。
玄帝没让他起来，这可是危险信号。
“宁爱卿，你觉得朕是不是太仁慈了？”
宁自明又惊又懵逼，颤声说道：“陛下乃是仁义之君，文治武功无人可及，百姓...”
话还没说完，玄帝一声冷哼！
“仁义之君？你的意思是朕太过仁慈，所以你们才敢违抗圣命？”
宁自明脑子嗡嗡地，不知道怎么回答？
啪的一声！
玄帝将手里的奏折重重地摔在龙案上。
content_en:
Ning Ziming found out that Ning Chen had sneaked out and was very angry.
He was worried that if Ning Chen told what happened recently, it would be terrible if it reached Emperor Xuan's ears!
Ning Ziming waited and waited. He didn't wait for Ning Chen, but he waited until the eunuch was summoned in the palace.
Hearing that Emperor Xuan summoned him to the palace, Ning Ziming felt very anxious and uneasy!
He secretly gave money to the summoned eunuch and wanted to know why Emperor Xuan summoned him?
But the money was collected when he summoned the eunuch, but he didn't know when he asked... In fact, he really didn't know.
Ning Ziming followed the summoned eunuch to the imperial study room of the palace.
Father-in-law Quan was standing at the door, looking at him with a smile on his face.
Something was wrong with Ning Ziming, so he hurriedly knelt down and shouted: "I, Ning Ziming, please see your majesty!"
"Hush...Master Ning, His Majesty is handling government affairs, please don't make any noise, just wait!"
Ning Ziming could only kneel and wait outside the door.
He wanted to find out the information from Quan's father-in-law, but Quan's father-in-law turned around and went in.
Ning Ziming knelt for more than two hours.
He was a civil servant with a frail body. His knees hurt when he knelt down, stars appeared in his eyes, and his waist felt like it was about to break.
But Emperor Xuan didn't summon him, so he had to kneel all the time.
Until he could no longer hold on, Father-in-law Quan came out.
"Master Ning, come with me to see the saint!"
Ning Ziming struggled to get up, his legs were swaying, and he knelt for a long time. He stood up suddenly, his blood was blocked, and his vision went dark and he almost fell down.
He held on for dear life.
It is disrespectful to lose etiquette in front of the palace.
He entered the Imperial Study Room tremblingly, knelt down again and shouted: "I'd like to see you, Your Majesty!"
Emperor Xuan looked away from the memorial in his hand and gave him a cold look.
Ning Ziming broke out in cold sweat on his forehead.
Emperor Xuan didn't let him get up, which was a danger signal.
"Ning Aiqing, do you think I am too kind?"
Ning Ziming was shocked and confused, and said in a trembling voice: "Your Majesty is a benevolent and righteous king. His civil and military skills are unparalleled. The people..."
Before he finished speaking, Emperor Xuan snorted coldly!
"Lord of Benevolence and Righteousness? You mean that I am too merciful, so you dare to disobey the Holy Order?"
Ning Ziming's mind was buzzing and he didn't know how to answer?
Snap!
Emperor Xuan threw the memorial in his hand heavily on the dragon table.
title_en: Chapter 15 Your Majesty’s forgiveness Chapter 16 Going too far
